Loveable.dev gets your site from zero to launch-ready fast. But when you need fine-grained control over code, design tweaks, or integrations, you need a developer-grade workspace that still respects what Loveable already built. That’s why we pair Loveable with OpenAI Codex for our Prism clients. It keeps the AI-powered speed while giving us GitHub-native editing and review.
Loveable will provision a GitHub repository and surface the repo URL. Copy it, because you’ll need it for Codex.
Codex identified the correct files, made the update, and pushed commits back to GitHub automatically, without undoing Loveable’s structure.

Return to your Loveable project and refresh. Your update (like that new blue primary color) should appear. If it doesn’t show immediately, give it a moment or refresh. Loveable sometimes caches versions before syncing the latest commit.
Connecting to Codex gives you an escape hatch. You can patch, extend, and optimize without abandoning Loveable’s speed.

Hey founder, ever stare at your inbox wondering where the hell all the potential customers went? You're hustling on your product, but crickets on the lead front means zero sales, zero growth. Brutal, right? Enter Alex Hormozi's $100M Leads, the no-BS guide to turning strangers into eager buyers. Hormozi, who's scaled gyms and SaaS to insane levels, lays out how to flood your pipeline without blowing your budget.
## First, Get This Straight: Leads Aren't Just Names, They're Engaged Folks Ready to Buy

Hormozi hits hard: A lead isn't some random email; it's someone you can contact who's shown interest in what you sell. Engaged leads? They're the ones opting in because you dangled something juicy: a "lead magnet" that solves a real pain fast.

We apply this at Prism by crafting lead magnets baked into your designs, like pop-up opt-ins on sites or app demos that capture emails. Our content team whips up ebooks or videos tailored to your niche, feeding straight into funnels that nurture 'em to sales. Result? Warmer leads, higher close rates, less wasted ad spend.

Startup teams, listen up. This is your anti-fragile playbook. A SaaS founder might warm-reach old colleagues, post killer LinkedIn threads, cold-email prospects from conferences, and run targeted Facebook ads. Mix 'em, and leads flow steady.

Prism amps this with tech: We design multi-channel funnels, AI-powered chatbots for warm chats, content calendars for organic reach, automated cold sequences via apps, and ad creatives that A/B test on autopilot. For a local bakery client, we blended Instagram Reels (free content) with Google Ads, tripling walk-ins in a month.

Hormozi's Hook-Retain-Reward system is fire for free content. Hook with a bold promise, retain by delivering value bombs, reward with calls-to-action that lead to your offer. Post everywhere: Social, blogs, podcasts. Build that "free goodwill" Hormozi raves about.

We live this at Prism: Our designs make content pop with eye-catching sites, video embeds, and SEO-juiced blogs. Add AI for personalization (like suggesting related reads), and your retain game levels up. We built a content funnel for a tech startup that turned weekly posts into 50+ monthly leads, no ads needed.

Once leads roll in, get "lead getters": referrals from happy clients, affiliates who promote for commissions, even agencies or employees hustling for you. Hormozi calls this leveraging others to multiply your reach without more work.

At Prism, AI's our edge: Tools that scrape niches for magnet ideas, design A/B-tested funnels, crank out content drafts, and optimize ads in real-time. Testing? Simulate campaigns with data models, tweak based on insights, launch winners. For startup teams buried in ops, this means more leads with less grind, leveling up against giants.

Ready to flood your funnel? Drop us a line for a free lead-gen audit. Let's craft systems that pull in strangers and turn 'em into superfans. What's your biggest lead headache? Spill in the comments and we'll brainstorm fixes on the spot.
